reviews_no_self_approval_ck.name: reviews_no_self_approval_ck
reviews_no_self_approval_ck.value: "reviews"."approved_by" is null or "reviews"."user_id" is null or "reviews"."approved_by" <> "reviews"."user_id"

reviews_approval_coherence_ck.name: reviews_approval_coherence_ck
reviews_approval_coherence_ck.value: ("reviews"."status" <> 'aprobada') or ("reviews"."approved_by" is not null and "reviews"."approved_at" is not null)

carts_owner_ck.name: carts_owner_ck
carts_owner_ck.value: "carts"."user_id" is not null or "carts"."session_token" is not null

coupons_window_ck.name: coupons_window_ck
coupons_window_ck.value: "coupons"."starts_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" is null or "coupons"."starts_at" < "coupons"."ends_at"

orders_paid_at_ck.name: orders_paid_at_ck
orders_paid_at_ck.value: "orders"."status" not in ('pagado','en_preparacion','enviado','entregado') or "orders"."paid_at" is not null

payment_events_order_ck.name: payment_events_order_ck
payment_events_order_ck.value: "payment_events"."processed_at" is null or "payment_events"."processing_started_at" is not null
